body:
## Parent

Ticket BK1 of spec #2963: read busy time from an iCal file and compute the open slots. Size: M.

**Base branch:** `book` in `openwizdev/WizSite` (the integration branch for spec #2963). Open the pull request against `book`, never `main`: a merge to `main` deploys the site, and that waits for the maintainer.

**Rules:** no new npm dependency; Node.js 24 standard library and the Workers runtime only (`fetch`, `crypto.subtle`, `Intl`); follow `contracts/comments.v1.md`; no secret, real email address or real calendar data in code, tests, fixtures or logs.

## What to build

Pure modules, no network and no clock of their own (the caller passes `nowMs`):

- `lib/book/ical.js`: `export function busyFromIcal(text, fromMs, toMs)` returns merged, ascending `[{start, end}]` (epoch ms) of busy time overlapping the window.
  - Handles line unfolding, `DTSTART`/`DTEND`/`DURATION`, UTC (`Z`), `TZID=` zones (convert with `Intl.DateTimeFormat`, DST included) and floating times (read in the calendar's `X-WR-TIMEZONE`, else UTC).
  - Not busy: all-day events (`VALUE=DATE`), `TRANSP:TRANSPARENT`, `STATUS:CANCELLED`.
  - Recurrence: `RRULE` with `FREQ` DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY or YEARLY, `INTERVAL`, `COUNT`, `UNTIL`, `BYDAY` (with ordinals such as `2TU` and `-1FR` for MONTHLY), `BYMONTHDAY`, `BYMONTH`, `WKST`; `EXDATE`; `RECURRENCE-ID` overrides (a moved or cancelled instance replaces the generated one). Occurrences keep their local wall time across DST.
  - Fail closed: text that is not a calendar, an event that cannot be read, or a rule part it does not support (`BYSETPOS`, `BYWEEKNO`, `BYYEARDAY`, `FREQ` below DAILY, `RDATE`) throws an `Error` whose `code` is `'calendar_unreadable'`. The message names the reason, never event text. Cap the work (at most 5,000 events and 20,000 generated occurrences), else the same error.
- `lib/book/slots.js`:
  - `export function settings(env)` returns `{mode, timezone, days, startMin, endMin, slotMin, bufferMin, noticeMin, horizonDays, maxPerDay}` from `BOOK_MODE` (`off` default, `fake`, `live`), `BOOK_TIMEZONE` (`America/Los_Angeles`), `BOOK_DAYS` (`1,2,3,4,5`; 0 is Sunday), `BOOK_START` (`11:00`), `BOOK_END` (`18:00`), `BOOK_BUFFER_MIN` (15), `BOOK_NOTICE_HOURS` (4), `BOOK_HORIZON_DAYS` (14), `BOOK_MAX_PER_DAY` (4); `slotMin` is always 30. A malformed value throws an `Error` with `code` `'bad_settings'`; an unknown mode is `off`.
  - `export function openSlots(cfg, busy, bookings, nowMs)` returns ascending slot starts (epoch ms): on the half hour in `cfg.timezone` inside the hours and days, wholly inside the day's hours, at least `noticeMin` after `nowMs`, within `horizonDays`, with `bufferMin` clear on each side of every `busy` interval and every booking (`[{start, end}]`), and none on a local day that already has `maxPerDay` bookings. DST days are right (a 23- or 25-hour day still offers 11:00 to 18:00 local).
  - `export function window(cfg, nowMs)` returns `{fromMs, toMs}`, the span the caller must read busy time for.
- `lib/book/fake.js`: `export function fakeBusy(cfg, fromMs, toMs)`: a deterministic, believable fake calendar (a few meetings on each weekday, the same for the same dates), for previews and tests.

## Owned paths

- `lib/book/ical.js`, `lib/book/slots.js`, `lib/book/fake.js` in `openwizdev/WizSite`
- `tests/book-core.test.mjs`, `tests/book-fixtures/ical/` in `openwizdev/WizSite`

**Relies on:** nothing

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Red first, then green: `node --test tests/book-core.test.mjs`, with synthetic `.ics` fixtures for each rule above, both DST changes, an override, an `EXDATE`, a cancelled and a transparent event, and each fail-closed case
- [ ] Slot tests pin the buffers, notice, horizon, daily cap, day and hour edges, and a booking beside a busy event
- [ ] `npm run build && npm run check && npm test` still pass

body:
## Parent

Ticket BK3 of spec #2963: the outbound pieces, confirmation email and Google Calendar. Size: M.

**Base branch:** `book` in `openwizdev/WizSite` (the integration branch for spec #2963). Open the pull request against `book`, never `main`: a merge to `main` deploys the site, and that waits for the maintainer.

**Rules:** no new npm dependency; Node.js 24 standard library and the Workers runtime only (`fetch`, `crypto.subtle`, `Intl`); follow `contracts/comments.v1.md`; no secret, real email address or real calendar data in code, tests, fixtures or logs.

## What to build

Modules that take `fetch` as an argument (`{fetch}`; default the global), so tests pass a fake. A `booking` is `{id, start, end, name, email, team, tz, cancelUrl}` with `start`/`end` in epoch ms.

- `lib/book/mail.js`:
  - `export function icsFor(booking, env)`: a valid single-event `VCALENDAR` text (UTC times, CRLF lines, folded at 75 octets, text escaped, `UID` `<id>@openwiz.dev`, summary `OpenWiz call`, the `BOOK_MEETING_URL` as location when set).
  - `export async function sendBookingMail(env, booking, {fetch})` returns `'sent'`, `'skipped'` (no `RESEND_API_KEY`) or `'failed'`; it never throws. Through Resend's `POST https://api.resend.com/emails` (10 s timeout, `Idempotency-Key` from the booking id), from `BOOK_FROM` (default `OpenWiz <book@openwiz.dev>`):
    1. to the visitor: a fixed template, plain text and simple dark HTML: the time in the visitor's `tz` (falling back to Pacific) and in Pacific, 30 minutes, the meeting link when `BOOK_MEETING_URL` is set (else one line saying the link follows by email), the cancel link, and the `.ics` attached. **It carries no text the visitor typed** (not the name, not the team line), so the form cannot be used to send someone else a message.
    2. to `BOOK_OWNER_EMAIL` when set: the name, email (as `reply_to`) and team line, HTML-escaped, and the time in Pacific.
    The result is the visitor message's outcome.
  - `export async function sendCancelMail(env, booking, {fetch})`: the same two recipients, same rules, same three results.
- `lib/book/google.js`, for when `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` and `GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN` are all set (`BOOK_GOOGLE_CALENDAR` defaults to `primary`):
  - `export function googleReady(env)`: true only when all three are set.
  - `export async function googleBusy(env, fromMs, toMs, {fetch})`: merged ascending `[{start, end}]` from the free/busy API; any failure throws an `Error` with `code` `'calendar_unreadable'`.
  - `export async function googleInsert(env, booking, {fetch})`: inserts the event (summary `OpenWiz call: <name>`, the team line and email in the description, the visitor as attendee, `sendUpdates=none`, a deterministic event id derived from the booking id so a retry cannot double-book) and returns the event id, or `null` on any failure.
  - `export async function googleDelete(env, eventId, {fetch})`: true when deleted or already gone, else false.
  - The access token comes from the refresh token on each call (10 s timeouts). No token, secret or response body is ever logged or put in an error.

## Owned paths

- `lib/book/mail.js`, `lib/book/google.js` in `openwizdev/WizSite`
- `tests/book-out.test.mjs` in `openwizdev/WizSite`

**Relies on:** nothing

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Red first, then green: `node --test tests/book-out.test.mjs` against a fake `fetch`: the exact requests, each failure path (timeout, non-2xx, malformed JSON), the no-key skip, and that a name or team line full of markup or a URL never reaches the visitor's message
- [ ] The `.ics` text parses back (line length, escaping, CRLF) in a test
- [ ] `npm run build && npm run check && npm test` still pass

body:
## Parent

Ticket BK2 of spec #2963: the booking API on Cloudflare Pages Functions. Size: L.

**Base branch:** `book` in `openwizdev/WizSite` (the integration branch for spec #2963). Open the pull request against `book`, never `main`: a merge to `main` deploys the site, and that waits for the maintainer.

**Rules:** no new npm dependency; Node.js 24 standard library and the Workers runtime only (`fetch`, `crypto.subtle`, `Intl`); follow `contracts/comments.v1.md`; no secret, real email address or real calendar data in code, tests, fixtures or logs.

## What to build

The four routes of the spec's contract (`openwiz.book.v1`), exactly as the spec states them, on top of BK1's `lib/book/ical.js`, `slots.js`, `fake.js` and BK3's `lib/book/mail.js`, `google.js` (already on `book`; read them, do not change them):

- `functions/api/book/slots.js` (`GET`), `functions/api/book/index.js` (`POST /api/book`), `functions/api/book/cancel.js` (`POST`), `functions/api/book/feed.js` (`GET`). Each exports `onRequest` and a testable `handle(request, env, {fetch, now})`. Other methods get `405`.
- **Busy time:** mode `fake` uses `fakeBusy`; mode `live` uses `googleBusy` when `googleReady(env)`, else fetches `BOOK_ICAL_URL` (https only, 10 s timeout, at most 2 MB, no redirects off https) through `busyFromIcal`. Mode `off`, missing settings, a missing database or any read failure answers `503 unavailable`. The iCal address is a secret: never in a response, error or log.
- **Storage** (`lib/book/store.js`): D1 at `env.BOOK_DB ?? env.ASK_A_WIZ_COUNTERS`. Tables created on first use: `book_bookings (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, start INTEGER, end INTEGER, name, email, team, tz, status, cancel_hash, google_event, created INTEGER)` with a unique index on `start` where `status = 'booked'`, and `book_limits (day TEXT, key TEXT, count INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (day, key))`. Every store call has a 5 s timeout.
- **Booking:** same-origin `Origin`, `Content-Type: application/json`, body at most 4 KB, exactly the contract's keys, the field limits of the spec, a plausible single email address. A filled `website` honeypot answers the normal `200` shape with a made-up id and stores and sends nothing. Then: rate limits, then re-read busy time and bookings and accept `start` only if `openSlots` offers it now (else `409 slot_taken`), then insert (a unique-index conflict is `409 slot_taken`), then `googleInsert` when ready (best effort; keep the event id), then `sendBookingMail` (its result is the answer's `email`). The id is 16 random bytes, base64url; the cancel token is 32 random bytes, stored only as its SHA-256; the cancel link is `https://<this origin>/book/?cancel=<id>.<token>`.
- **Rate limits** (D1 counters keyed by a daily-salted hash of `CF-Connecting-IP`, as `functions/api/ask.js` does; never the raw address): slots 120 an hour per visitor; booking attempts 10 an hour per visitor; bookings 3 a day per visitor, 2 upcoming per email address, 20 a day overall. Over a limit: `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`.
- **Cancel:** constant-time token check; marks the row `cancelled` (the slot opens again), `googleDelete` when there is an event, `sendCancelMail`. Unknown id, wrong token or a past booking: `404 not_found`. A second cancel: `200`.
- **Feed:** as the contract says; constant-time compare; never cached.
- `scripts/book-dev.mjs`: a local preview server with no dependency: serves `dist/` and routes `/api/book/*` to the handlers with an in-memory `node:sqlite` database behind a D1-shaped wrapper, `BOOK_MODE=fake` by default, `--port` (default 8801), bound to 127.0.0.1. It sends no email and calls no outside service unless the matching environment variables are set.
- `package.json`: add `tests/book-*.test.mjs` to `test:functions`.
- `docs/maintaining.md`: one short section, *Booking*: the routes, every setting and secret by name with its default, and the switch.

## Owned paths

- `functions/api/book/`, `lib/book/store.js`, `scripts/book-dev.mjs` in `openwizdev/WizSite`
- `tests/book-api.test.mjs` in `openwizdev/WizSite`
- `package.json` (shared: the `test:functions` line only), `docs/maintaining.md` (shared: the Booking section only)

**Relies on:** BK1, BK3 (merged to `book`)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Red first, then green: `npm run test:functions`, with a `node:sqlite` fake D1 as `tests/ask.test.mjs` does: every status in the contract, each rate limit, the honeypot, a double booking of one slot (two requests, one `409`), a slot outside hours or inside a buffer refused, cancel then rebook, the feed's three answers, a calendar read failure (`503`, nothing leaked), a D1 failure and timeout
- [ ] No response, error or log line carries the iCal address, a token or a raw IP address (asserted in tests)
- [ ] `npm run build && npm run check && npm test` still pass; `node scripts/book-dev.mjs` serves slots and takes a booking in fake mode

body:
## Parent

Ticket BK4 of spec #2963: the booking page and its installable app. Size: L.

**Base branch:** `book` in `openwizdev/WizSite` (the integration branch for spec #2963). Open the pull request against `book`, never `main`: a merge to `main` deploys the site, and that waits for the maintainer.

**Rules:** no new npm dependency; Node.js 24 standard library and the Workers runtime only (`fetch`, `crypto.subtle`, `Intl`); follow `contracts/comments.v1.md`; no secret, real email address or real calendar data in code, tests, fixtures or logs.

## What to build

`/book` (`book/index.html`, `book/book.css`, `book/book.js`), in the OpenWiz design: read `tokens.css`, `site.css` and `team/index.html` first and match them (dark, restrained, Geist, the brass call-to-action, generous space). It should be the best-looking page on the site. Phone first; no framework, no inline script or style.

- **The flow, with as few taps as possible:** the page loads `GET /api/book/slots` and opens with the first day that has a free time already selected and its times showing. A row of days (next 14 days; days with no time are dimmed and skipped by the keyboard), then that day's times as large tap targets, in the visitor's own time zone with the zone named. Tapping a time opens the form in place: name, email, "One line about your team", and one **Book the call** button. Then `POST /api/book` (the contract is in the spec, #2963; send `tz`; include the hidden honeypot field `website`, off-screen, `tabindex="-1"`, `autocomplete="off"`, not `display:none`).
- **After booking:** a calm confirmation in place: the time, "A confirmation is on its way to <email>" (or, when the answer's `email` is not `sent`, "You're booked. Save the time below."), an **Add to calendar** button that downloads an `.ics` built in the browser, and a one-line hint on installing the page as an app.
- **States:** loading (quiet skeleton, no spinner wall), no free time, `slot_taken` (say so, reload the times, keep what was typed), `rate_limited`, `unavailable` (one plain line, plus a `mailto:`-free fallback: a link to `/team/`), offline (cached shell, one line saying booking needs a connection). Inline field errors, focus moved to the first one; everything works by keyboard and is announced to screen readers (`aria-live`); reduced motion respected; text contrast at least 4.5:1.
- **Cancel:** `/book/?cancel=<id>.<token>` shows "Cancel this call?" with one button, which posts to `/api/book/cancel` and then shows "Cancelled" and a link to book again. The token is removed from the address bar with `history.replaceState` once read.
- **Copy:** left (or top on phones): "Book 30 minutes with Jake" style heading, the team page's promise in one or two lines, and the three facts (30 minutes; your repo and your agent; a pull request ships). **No price, no payment, nothing about cost.**
- **App:** `book/manifest.webmanifest` (name "Book OpenWiz", `id`, `start_url` and `scope` `/book/`, `display` standalone, the page's ground colour, 192 and 512 px PNG icons and a maskable one, made from the existing brand mark) and `book/sw.js` (scope `/book/`): caches the page shell and its styles, scripts and fonts as they are fetched, network first for the page; never touches `/api/`; old caches removed on activate. In standalone display mode the site's top bar and footer are hidden, so it reads as an app.
- **Site wiring:** the page uses the same top bar and shared footer as the other site pages. `build.mjs` builds and fingerprints it; `_headers` gives `/book/*` a strict policy like `/app/*` (`connect-src 'self'`, `worker-src 'self'`, `manifest-src 'self'`, `form-action 'none'`); `scripts/check.py` learns the page (its files, links, copy, the manifest and worker, no price words, no form posting anywhere but the API) with `scripts/test_check.py` cases; `docs/maintaining.md` gets a short *The booking page* paragraph. **Do not change `team/index.html` or the booking-link rule: the team page keeps its current link.** Nothing links to `/book` from another page yet.
- `scripts/book-check.mjs`: a browser check in the style of `scripts/app-check.mjs` (Chrome over the DevTools protocol, no dependency) with the API mocked: the whole flow at 390 and 1280 px wide, each state above, the keyboard path, no horizontal overflow, the cancel view, and screenshots written to a folder given by `--shots`.

## Owned paths

- `book/` in `openwizdev/WizSite`
- `scripts/book-check.mjs`, `scripts/book-fixtures/` in `openwizdev/WizSite`
- `build.mjs`, `_headers`, `scripts/check.py`, `scripts/test_check.py`, `docs/maintaining.md` (shared: the booking page's parts only)

**Relies on:** nothing (the API is mocked from the spec's contract)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `npm run build && npm run check && npm test` pass, with new `test_check.py` cases that go red when the page loses its manifest, gains a price word, or posts a form elsewhere
- [ ] `node scripts/book-check.mjs --shots <dir>` passes at both widths; the pull request shows the phone and desktop screenshots of the picker, the form, the confirmation and the unavailable state
- [ ] Chrome's installability check passes for `/book/` (manifest, icons, worker), shown in the check
